تستسقون (form X)
# تَسْتَسْقُونَ (tastasqūna) /tas.tas.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# تُسْتَسْقَوْنَ (tustasqawna) /tus.tas.qaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
